scope: MAC-10 adapter dry-runs and live task evaluation
changes: QA credits source only after byte verification against the last completed request's exact serialized body, tool call, path, source range and file version.
Repair keeps the frozen oracle as its verdict and applies the same source budget to both arms. A receipt for a previous version is checked against the captured version from the attempt.
Every product session records its FRESH wait, published build mode and reason, and the before/after delta of owner query counters. A rebind creates a separate session sample.
interpretation: The source budget covers source slices. Outline structure and rg navigation are recorded separately.
The Q10 matrix estimates historical dev regression performance. It does not establish generalization.
Request receipts verify source attachment to the dispatched body, not whether the model used the source.
